correction: Measures 1, 2 and 5 in v1 were computed by an instrument with an INVERTED partner-turn filter and are not usable as exit evidence. v1 is left intact as the historical record rather than edited, on the same principle as the event log: an artifact is rewritten by superseding it, never by making the old one read as if it had been right.

what_was_wrong.1_inverted_promptSource_filter: tools/displacement-baselines.py excluded records whose promptSource is 'sdk' as scripted traffic. Measured across the whole transcript corpus on 2026-08-13 by this session, independently of the reporting session: promptSource is ABSENT on 46,029 user records, reads 'sdk' on 2,718, and reads 'typed' on exactly 2. Joe's own prompts carry 'sdk', because the desktop app drives Claude Code through the SDK. The filter therefore discarded nearly every genuine partner turn and kept hook feedback, which carries no promptSource at all.
what_was_wrong.2_injected_stripped_only_a_header: The machine-text pattern removed only a leading header line, so a conduct gate arriving as 'Stop hook feedback:' followed by its body kept the whole body, cleared the 12-character floor, and counted as a partner turn. Contamination measured by the reporting session: 194 of 207 counted turns, 94%, were machine-authored.
what_was_wrong.3_handoff_pattern_matched_the_machinery: Measure 5's handoff pattern matches the bare word 'handoff', which the harness's own CONTEXT HANDOFF GATE contains, so the machinery's notice counted as evidence Joe hand-carried context.

unaffected: Measures 3 and 4 are sound and unchanged in method: 3 counts tool invocations and 4 is human-timed, so neither reads the partner-turn filter.
verification: The corrected instrument ships with tools/test_displacement_turn_filter.py, 25 assertions in both failure directions — it must reject machine text AND keep short genuine turns. Run here before recomputing: 25/25 pass. The second direction is not decoration: an earlier draft of the fix compiled its machine pattern case-insensitively and ate real turns beginning 'investigate', 'navigate' and 'propagate'.
source_doctrine: carr-workspace-bduf section s01a 'Operating objective and AI-session displacement test'
doctrine_rule: Before implementation, instrument or interview the following measures. Do not invent a baseline. Store the evidence method, observation window, result, bound product action, and post-launch comparison for each measure.
register_rule: carr-workspace-bduf s27 and carr-control-room-bduf s34: the register must name the method, owner, and observation window rather than fabricate a value.
baseline_context: These measure the CURRENT world, before CARR Workspace and CARR Control Room ship. Tasks are performed with the partner's existing tools, never against the Phase 0 prototypes. Timing a partner on the prototypes would measure the proposed system rather than the baseline it is supposed to beat, and would make the post-launch comparison meaningless.

window.note: The transcript corpus begins 2026-07-16, so a longer window is not measurable. Rates below are per-week over the ACTUAL span, not extrapolated.

measure_1_weekly_heavy_session_time.method: active time as a UNION of inter-record gaps <= 10 minutes, restricted to sessions the partner actually typed in
measure_1_weekly_heavy_session_time.JUDGMENT_STILL_REQUIRED: This is TOTAL active time. The baseline doctrine asks for ROUTINE OPERATION time only, because objective 8 permits heavy sessions for exploration, investigation and construction. Splitting the two is a judgment call this script will not fake.

measure_2_questions_needing_agent_explan.method: user turns matching a question shape, excluding tool results

measure_3_actions_not_completable_visual.method: record-layer verb invocations; every one is an action that required an AI session because no visual control exists for it
measure_3_actions_not_completable_visual.CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Joe confirms which of these genuinely had no visual route. A verb called by a session on its own initiative is not the same as an action he could not otherwise perform.

measure_5_hand_carried_context_transfers.method: sessions in window, plus partner turns carrying context by hand
measure_5_hand_carried_context_transfers.note: Each session boundary is a potential transfer; a turn matching the handoff shape is one that actually carried context by hand.
